# LVMH

> > The world's leading luxury goods group, uniting 75+ prestigious Maisons across fashion, leather goods, perfumes, cosmetics, wines, spirits, watches, jewelry, and selective retailing.

LVMH (Moët Hennessy Louis Vuitton) represents exceptional savoir-faire and French luxury heritage through iconic brands including Louis Vuitton, Dior, Celine, Givenchy, TAG Heuer, and Château d'Yquem. The group champions craftsmanship, innovation, and talent development while maintaining leadership in the global luxury industry.

## Key Topics

- LVMH Maisons and portfolio divisions
- French savoir-faire and craftsmanship
- Louis Vuitton heritage and innovation
- Fashion & leather goods excellence
- Luxury perfumes and contemporary perfumery
- Maria Grazia Chiuri and creative directors
- Paris luxury retail and flagship boutiques
- TAG Heuer and luxury watches
- Brand ambassadors and partnerships
- Talent development and recruitment
- Formula 1 and special events sponsorship
- Le Bon Marché Rive Gauche selective retailing
- Italian luxury heritage
- Monogram canvas and iconic designs
- Luxury industry leadership

## Maisons & Business Divisions

- [Fashion & Leather goods](https://www.lvmh.com/en/our-maisons/fashion-leather-good): Fashion & Leather Goods division featuring Louis Vuitton, Dior, Celine
- [Maison Francis Kurkdjian](https://www.lvmh.com/en/our-maisons/perfumes-cosmetics/maison-francis-kurkdjian): Francis Kurkdjian's contemporary perfume house under LVMH portfolio
- [Givenchy Parfums](https://www.lvmh.com/en/our-maisons/perfumes-cosmetics/givenchy-parfums): Givenchy Parfums with L'Interdit and Gentleman Society fragrances
- [Château d'Yquem, Sauternes Premier Cru](https://www.lvmh.com/en/our-maisons/wines-spirits/chateau-dyquem): Château d'Yquem Premier Cru Sauternes wine estate in Aquitaine
- [Cova](https://www.lvmh.com/en/our-maisons/other-activities/cova): Cova historic Italian pasticceria on Milan's Via Montenapoleone since 1817
